text:
mira: Anyone else seeing our model-serving pods stuck Pending in us-west1? CA should be adding GPU nodes but nothing's happening. @ops-sre
samir: pinging — can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` and `kubectl describe pod` for one of the pending pods?
mira: sure
mira: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n models
NAME                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
bert-server-7f6c9d5b8-kqz2  0/1     Pending   0          4m
```
mira: `kubectl describe pod bert-server-7f6c9d5b8-kqz2 -n models` shows the usual Unschedulable message: "0/10 nodes are available: 10 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector." and no toleration-related message.
leo: do we have node taints on GPU pools? I remember we taint preemptible/pool for routing.
samir: yep, our gpu pools get `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` and `preemptible=true:NoSchedule` depending on pool. if the pod doesn't have tolerations for those taints it won't schedule even if a node exists. but CA should still scale if pod is unschedulable due to resource (requests). curious.
anika: can you paste the pod's spec? maybe there's a required nodeAffinity that doesn't match node labels for that pool.
mira: here's the pod template from the Deployment (abbreviated):
mira: ```yaml
spec:
  containers:
  - name: bert
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: hardware.gpu
            operator: In
            values:
            - a100
  # no tolerations present
```
leo: OK — required nodeAffinity says gpu type must be `a100`. our nodepools are labeled `hardware.gpu=a100` in us-west1-a pool, but the autoscaler scales the wrong ASG/nodegroup in us-west1-b which has label `hardware.gpu=A100` (capitalization mismatch).
samir: ugh. case-sensitive label mismatch. CA won't consider a nodegroup that doesn't match the pod's affinity when deciding scale-up for that pod, so it thinks there is no matching nodegroup and bails.
ops-sre-bot: [cluster-autoscaler] Event: PodNotTriggerScaleUp: pod "bert-server-7f6c9d5b8-kqz2" pod's node affinity/selector doesn't match any nodegroup labels
mira: so two issues: 1) missing tolerations for the `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` taint (if nodegroup has taint, pod still wouldn't schedule post-scale), 2) label mismatch prevents CA from selecting the right nodegroup to scale.
anika: fix plan: update Deployment to add a toleration for `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` and normalize label expectations (preferred: change pod affinity to use `hardware.gpu in (a100,A100)` or better, standardize node labels during nodepool create).
leo: quick patch we can roll now:
leo: ```yaml
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - key: "dedicated"
        operator: "Equal"
        value: "gpu"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
      nodeSelector:
        hardware.gpu: a100
```
samir: note: switching to nodeSelector reduces flexibility; prefer tolerations + preferredDuringScheduling for affinity so CA can still pick the right nodegroup if labels standardize later.
mira: happy to apply toleration only as a short-term fix. however, there's another dimension: cost/region. us-west1-a is out of quota and A100s are really expensive — we should prefer preemptible T4s for dev, A100s for prod. right now the Deployment just asks for `nvidia.com/gpu: 1` and affinity to a100 — we could add a `nodeSelectorTerms` with topology spread for preference instead of required.
leo: suggestion: add a label `redwood.deck=gpu-prod` to prod nodepools and use `preferredDuringScheduling` matching that label, plus tolerations for taint. That way CA can scale the gpu-prod nodegroup only when prod pods are pending.
anika: also add validation in admission webhook: deny requiredDuringScheduling with exact case label mismatches (we keep mangled labels causing these bugs).
samir: if you want a quick `kubectl patch` to add toleration to live Deployment:
samir: ```bash
kubectl -n models patch deployment bert-server --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/tolerations","value":[{"key":"dedicated","operator":"Equal","value":"gpu","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}]'
```
mira: running that now in staging, will monitor. :hourglass:
dev-deploy-bot: Deployment bert-server patched in namespace models (staging)
mira: staging pods came up after CA scaled an A100 nodegroup in us-west1-a — looks good. will schedule a quick infra PR to standardize labels and add nodepool-level docs.
leo: for follow-up: (1) add a linter in our k8s infra repo to prevent label case variants, (2) review CA config so it knows about all GPU nodegroups across regions, (3) create a small runbook: "If pods pending with GPU requests, check taints, tolerations, and node label case"
anika: I'll open the PR for label standardization and add the runbook. thanks everyone.
mira: thanks! :thumbsup:
